info.title: actualBudget API
info.description: Trusted-network application with no app login, cookies or bearer tokens. Native requests without Origin are supported. Browser API requests must match the configured public origin (or HTTP Host origin); cross-site fetches are rejected. All identifiers are canonical lowercase UUIDs; account/transaction identities are budget-scoped. Unknown JSON fields are rejected.

get.description: Ordinary ledger entries ordered by date descending, creation order descending, then ID. With account_id, running_balance includes all preceding entries and does not reset per page; all-account rows return null. Default totals include future dates. Explicit as_of limits balances and entries inclusively to that calendar date. Newest account page uses cached totals and an indexed bounded row read. Tombstoned entries are excluded.

post.description: New payee/category objects are created in the same transaction as the financial write and durable replay outcome; select an ID or create a reference, never both. Off-budget entries cannot have a category. Financial values and every account running/cleared/uncleared balance must remain safe integers.

post.description: Pure calculator input conversion, no idempotency key required. Canonical decimal dot input, whitespace ignored, + - * / ^ and parentheses. Baseline binary64 expression evaluation and Math.round-compatible ties toward positive infinity; negative primaries precede exponentiation, exponentiation is right-associative, valid expression prefixes ignore trailing characters. Nonfinite/out-of-range results rejected. Ledger storage and calculations remain exact integers.
